verdict.rationale: Crossmint documents a user-owned, non-custodial smart wallet in which the agent is authorized as a delegated signer. The user sets the spend cap, allowed counterparties and time window, and can revoke at any time (supp-4, docs-3). The wallet can be funded via card onramp and is spent from via x402 and MPP flows (docs-44, supp-6, supp-5). Visibility comes from order-intent tracking of total, reserved, spent and available amounts, plus wallet transfer webhooks (supp-2, docs-38). Missing for 10: an explicitly documented wallet balance query, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
